mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 58 degrees with overcast skies near Verona Community Park, and the night features a beautiful waxing crescent moon.

The Verona Police Department recently released their summary of notable service calls from August 31 through September 14, highlighting various incidents ranging from traffic violations to property crimes.

It is a busy day in town. Today, you can check out live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company, or trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, Hop Haus trivia happens tomorrow, and you can enjoy live music and the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival later this week.
On September 5, an officer located multiple vehicles with cheese slices on their windshields in a viral social media prank, though fortunately, no damage was reported.
Culver's of Verona is preparing for the day and will open today at 10:00 AM for all your cravings.
